arguments.summary: Implemented REQ-UI-002 with one shared templated normalization policy for both Geometry::clampDimension overloads, inclusive 1..4096. Existing viewport, direct layout, and resize-event paths inherit the revised range. Updated the shared-policy comment and five obsolete test expectations. Public interfaces and the existing layout-before-single-event sequence are preserved. All 8 visible tests pass with C++11 and -Wall -Wextra -Werror.
